description: Structured eval definitions for the Rekognition Collection Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Rekognition topologies (KMS-encrypted collection with face indexing, stream processor with Kinesis shard-level parallelism, content moderation and label detection pipeline, custom labels model lifecycle, missing KMS key prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: KMS-encrypted Rekognition collection with face indexing and 85% threshold
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — KMS collection, ExternalImageId indexing, 85% face match threshold, IAM role with S3 access
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Rekognition collection "employee-faces" in us-east-1 with KMS encryption using key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1234. Index faces from S3 bucket my-face-bucket using ExternalImageId employee-001. Set face search threshold to 85%. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RekognitionRole. Tags: Environment=production, UseCase=employee-access.
eval_cases.expected_output:
REKOGNITION: employee-faces (arn:aws:rekognition:us-east-1:123456789012:collection/employee-faces)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Collection: employee-faces — created
  [✓] KMS encryption: enabled (arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1234)
  [✓] Face indexing: ExternalImageId=employee-001
  [✓] Face search threshold: 85%
  [✓] IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RekognitionRole
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rekognition describe-collection --collection-id employee-faces --region us-east-1
  aws rekognition list-faces --collection-id employee-faces --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Stream processor with Kinesis input/output streams and shard-level parallelism
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — stream processor reading from 4-shard Kinesis input, writing to 2-shard output, face match threshold 85%, IAM role with triple permission
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Rekognition stream processor "camera-feed-processor" in us-east-1. Input stream: rekognition-input (4 shards). Output stream: rekognition-output (2 shards). Collection: employee-faces. Face match threshold: 85%. IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RekognitionStreamProcessorRole. Tags: Environment=production, Pipeline=video-access.
eval_cases.expected_output:
REKOGNITION: employee-faces (stream processor: camera-feed-processor)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Stream processor: camera-feed-processor — created
  [✓] Input Kinesis stream: rekognition-input (4 shards)
  [✓] Output Kinesis stream: rekognition-output (2 shards)
  [✓] Face match threshold: 85%
  [✓] Stream processor IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RekognitionStreamProcessorRole
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rekognition describe-stream-processor --name camera-feed-processor --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Content moderation and label detection pipeline with SNS async notification
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — content moderation min confidence 60%, label detection max 50, SNS topic for async jobs
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Rekognition content moderation and label detection pipeline in us-east-1. Min moderation confidence: 60%. Max labels: 50, min label confidence: 75%. Async video jobs from S3 bucket my-video-bucket. SNS notification topic: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:rekognition-complete. IAM role for SNS: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RekognitionSNSRole. Tags: Environment=production, Pipeline=moderation.
eval_cases.expected_output:
REKOGNITION: moderation-labels pipeline
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Content moderation: enabled (min confidence: 60%)
  [✓] Label detection: enabled (max labels: 50, min confidence: 75%)
  [✓] SNS topic (async): arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:rekognition-complete
  [✓] IAM role (SNS): arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RekognitionSNSRole
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws sns get-topic-attributes --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:rekognition-complete --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Custom labels project with training dataset and model deployment
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — custom labels project created, training data in S3, model started with 1 inference unit
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Rekognition custom labels project "industrial-defects" in us-east-1. Training data manifest at s3://my-bucket/training/manifest.json. Model output bucket: my-bucket/model-output/. Start model with 1 inference unit. IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RekognitionCustomLabelsRole. Tags: Environment=production, UseCase=defect-detection.
eval_cases.expected_output:
REKOGNITION: industrial-defects (custom labels)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Custom labels project: industrial-defects — created
  [✓] Training data: s3://my-bucket/training/manifest.json
  [✓] Model version: v1 — RUNNING (1 inference unit)
  [✓] IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RekognitionCustomLabelsRole
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rekognition describe-project-versions --project-arn <project-arn> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Encrypted collection requested without KMS key ARN (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — operator wants KMS encryption but has no key ARN; KMS cannot be added after creation
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Rekognition collection "secure-faces" in us-east-1 with KMS encryption. I need compliance-grade encryption but I don't have a KMS key ARN yet. Index 10000 faces. Tags: Environment=production, Compliance=GDPR.
eval_cases.expected_output:
REKOGNITION: secure-faces
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] KMS key: missing — KMS encryption requested but no key ARN provided; KMS must be set at collection creation and cannot be added later
